lesson_title: Four Kinds of Work: How South Africa Earns
hook_text: Farming feeds all 60 million of us — and earns 3% of the money. Wait, what?
clip_script: Measure the economy like a soccer team's goals and ask who scored. Here is the shock: farming — the work that feeds every single one of us — scores only about two or three goals out of every hundred. Mining, the industry that built Joburg, fewer than ten. All the factories together, about twenty. And the services — the banks, shops, taxis, schools, hospitals — score roughly two thirds of all the goals. But a small score is not a small importance: farming's few goals feed the team. No maize, no country.
visual_style: Animated scoreboard filling with sector goals over shots of a maize field, a mine headgear, a factory floor and a buzzing mall.
pacing: Hook with the paradox, count the scoreboard, land the twist.
